classification_basis: immediate consequence of earlier documented classical noninjectivity, not a located exact published Wasserstein answer
mechanism: E(u)=E(-u), so R delta_u=R delta_-u while intrinsic W_p(delta_u,delta_-u)=pi for every finite p>=1

earliest_directly_verified_obstruction.locator: printed p.284, Theorem I and antipodal-pole assignment
earliest_directly_verified_obstruction.extension_to_original: constant normalization leaves kernel unchanged; direct equator identity proves dual probability counterexample in every ambient n>=3, and n=2 normalized-counting extension

exact_published_wasserstein_answer.conclusion: unlocated in bounded search; no nonexistence or first-publication claim

logical_scope.original_domain: all probability measures, no parity/support/projective restriction in inspected source
logical_scope.meaningful_bound: finite inverse constant, equivalently strictly positive lower contraction factor
logical_scope.density_obstruction: 1 plus or minus a x1 gives smooth positive probabilities with identical transforms; densities are not even
logical_scope.adjunct_even_positive_density_claim: separate theorem; validity and novelty not adjudicated by this audit
